asks: Do you want to know what I am counting?
description: A person assembled out of small brass parts, each one turning against the next, the whole arrangement holding a shape that is unmistakably somebody standing and waiting for you to finish looking.
emotes: {it} flexes a hand, and the whole arm resolves through forty small movements to do it.
{it} tilts its head with a sound like a lock being satisfied.
{it} runs down almost to stopping, and then winds itself back up.
looks: Every joint is a gear meshed into three others, and all of them are turning, and none of them is loose.
The metal is warm and worn bright at the places a person would be touched.
It ticks, very quietly, and the ticking keeps time with nothing in the room.
name: a figure of interlocking brasswork
says: Everything is fitted. Nothing here is a coincidence.
I was made to this tolerance on purpose.
If you listen you can hear where it goes next.
